A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same MechVQA/MechVL study, with complete main text and Appendices A–C. Pages 2–28 have identical extracted text and rendered appearance. Differences are confined to the first-page code link, abstract reflow, and version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations and training/reward ablations in Tables 2–3, metadata correction results in Appendix B.2, and reward-weight experiments in Appendix C.3.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original benchmark evaluations, ablations, metadata correction analysis, and appendix experiments.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same Qwen3-VL-4B-based model, supervised fine-tuning, full-data and targeted DAPO stages, and accuracy/format/quality rewards. No algorithm or model component changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same MechVQA coverage: 3,281 drawings and 20,778 question–answer pairs spanning ten subtasks and three difficulty levels. No dataset, task, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains exactly the same open-source and closed-source comparators. Table 3 also retains the same GRPO, GSPO, DAPO, and reward-design comparisons.

E3.justification: The drawing-level 8:1:1 split, preprocessing, model configurations, training settings, accuracy metric, and three-judge evaluation procedure are unchanged in Sections 3–5 and Appendices B.6 and C.

E4.justification: Training-stage, optimizer, reward-design, and reward-weight ablations are identical. Difficulty analysis, expert-verification analysis, split visualization, and training-dynamics plots are also retained without revision.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run variability, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests for model performance. No uncertainty-reporting procedure is introduced or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted findings are identical, including appendix results. For example, Table 2 reports MechVL-4B-RL at 84.85 and Gemini-3-Pro-Preview at 77.28 in both versions.

T1.justification: The SFT objective, DAPO advantage and optimization definitions, and reward equations (1)–(7) are identical. No mathematical assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The benchmark novelty claim, MechVL contribution, and claimed 7.57-percentage-point advantage over the strongest closed-source baseline remain unchanged. The new code-access statement does not alter the core scientific claims.

C2.justification: Results interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged. Appendix A retains the same limitations concerning drawing coverage, visual clarity, contamination, incomplete benchmark validation, and redistribution permissions.

D1.justification: v2 adds an abstract statement that code is available, linking to the GitHub repository xiaofengShi/MechVQA; v1 has no corresponding project-code link. This adds access information, while implementation details remain identical. Repository contents and usability are not established by the PDFs.

R1.justification: Related work, cited research, dataset comparisons, and novelty positioning are unchanged. The added project-code link introduces no new comparison with prior research.

P1.justification: The abstract gains a short code-availability statement, and the arXiv version/date stamp changes. Existing scientific prose, terminology, section order, and appendix structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The abstract's line wrapping and spacing adjust to accommodate the new hyperlink, and the marginal version/date stamp changes. All figures, tables, captions, and layouts on pages 2–28 are visually identical.

improvement.justification: The new abstract link provides a concrete code-access location absent from v1, modestly improving resource discoverability and reproducibility documentation. Scientific content and supporting evidence remain identical. The PDFs do not establish repository completeness or usability, so the supported improvement is limited.
